claims.text: The FDA clonazepam label says concomitant use of benzodiazepines, including clonazepam, and opioids may result in profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma and death.
claims.quote: Concomitant use of benzodiazepines, including clonazepam tablets, and opioids may result in profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.

claims.text: The FDA clonazepam label says benzodiazepines act at GABA A sites and opioids act mainly at mu receptors.
claims.quote: Benzodiazepines interact at GABA A sites, and opioids interact primarily at mu receptors.

headline.text: The clonazepam label says combined use with opioids may cause profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma and death (c1).

reported.text: The label statement covers opioids as a class and does not name dihydrocodeine.

mechanism.text: The label says benzodiazepines act at GABA A sites and opioids mainly at mu receptors.

gaps.text: No controlled human study of this combination was found in the PubMed search.
